newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Gulf jet fuel diffs move up in thin trading.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Gulf jet fuel diffs move up in thin trading.

text.p: U.S. Gulf jet fuel differentials firmed in modest activity, although outright prices saw little movement.
On the NYMEX, September heating oil futures dipped 0.16 cent to settle at 55.09 cents a gallon.
USG prompt 54-grade jet fuel traded at 0.85 and 0.90 cent over the September futures, up about 0.20 cent from late last week, according to traders.
Prompt low sulphur 55-grade jet barrels were talked at about 1.20 cent over the NYMEX, holding their premium to the 54-grade, traders said.
